szoveg_eredeti:
It feels pretty fitting for @JensenHuang & @nvidia to end their European tour with Microducks on stage.

Microduck was designed and engineered in Europe (more precisely Bordeaux, France) by the @pollenrobotics and @huggingface teams. With American capital and ambition + Chinese manufacturing genius, it became the most popular robot of 2026 with over 15,000 sold all over the world!

I believe Europe has more opportunity to shine in AI than in any previous tech wave. We intend to prove it with @huggingface @nvidia and the whole open-source AI community in the coming years! 

Let's go European AI 🇪🇺🇪🇺🇪🇺
